en: Hello, welcome!
A new suit? Or would it be alterations?
This appears to be a tailor's shop.
And you are the owner of this shop?
Yes, that's me. I'm Darrell. Nice to meet you.
I take pride in my work.
When you need clothes made, do come to us.
Yes, one of these days.
(A skillful human makes a useful servant...)
Oh, it's you! Welcome to my shop.
So this is your shop.
It's a finer shop than I expected.
I'm glad to hear you say so.
Come by any time, won't you?
Oh, hello! Good to see you.
Sorry I can't get up. I'm busy today.
I've got a wife to support, you know.
You are married?
Ha ha, didn't I tell you before?
That I've got someone waiting at home?
We just got married. I'm a happy man.
I see. Be happy, then.
How about it? I'll make you a suit, cheap.
Alterations, anything at all, leave it to me.
I see. Then perhaps I'll ask you next time.
I hear your skill is famous in town, Darrell.
Oh, no, not at all. I've still got a lot to learn.
It's just that this is all I'm good at.
I mean to keep at it honestly all my life.
Come by my place sometime.
I'll have my wife make something tasty,
so why don't we have a nice long chat?
I guess you'd call it a reason to live.
Work I can put my heart into, a family I love.
I couldn't ask for anything more.
Oh, who might you be?
Excuse me.
note: Base for Quentin msg 172991 ("I seem to have come to the wrong place. / Excuse me."). Variant: msg 38085 name follows, then #762 '.'

en: I thought I should introduce myself.
I see. I'm Darrell. Pleased to meet you.
How kind of you to come by specially.
I'm a tailor by trade.
Do drop by the shop if you feel like it.
What is it?
, it's you! Come on in.
Feels a bit odd, somehow. I find it easier
to talk at the shop. My wife's here, see.
My wife's the shy type, you see.
I'll introduce you some time.
Oh, good of you to come!
I look forward to seeing you and chatting.
And not just to the shop. From now on, come
to the house often, too! You'll be welcome.
Come by any time you like.
You're up quite early yourself.
Likewise. Well, see you another time.
Ah, yes, you're right. It really is dark.
Thank you for the warning.
Are you on your way home from work?
Likewise. Well, take care.
Good evening, Darrell.
I'm glad to see you're well too.
I've got someone waiting for me at home.
Hello. This seems to be a tailor's shop.
Are you the owner of this shop?
Yes, I'll be sure to. That's very kind of you.
Hello. So this is your shop.
What a neat, lovely shop it is.
Yes, I'm sure I will. How kind of you.
I've got to earn enough for my wife, too.
Oh, so you're married.
Well, well. I wish you every happiness.
Sure. Then next time I'll bring along some
clothes I'd like you to work on.
I hear your work is famous in town, Darrell.
I'll have my wife make something tasty,
Nice to meet you.
I'm going around greeting the neighbors.
Oh, no need to be so formal.
These days, I really look forward to seeing
you and having a chat.
